BiblicalUsage: This word occurs exactly once, in Ecclesiastes 9:1: 'the righteous, and the wise, and their works are in the hand of God.' It names a deed or work — what a person does — set alongside the righteous and the wise as something held in God's hand.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse cannot carry a doctrine, and I will not pretend it does — but it does say plainly that my works rest in God’s hand once they are done.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
